content.text:
The failing suite is in the homework repo at `/Users/gupta/hw9`. A backward hop from the start row was getting through because the back-fence check used `newRow < -1`.

That check is `newRow < 0` again, so a hop behind the start row is blocked. `node --test` in that repo now passes all 19 tests.

The fix is only in the local `hw9` copy. It is not committed or pushed, so the GitHub Actions run is still red until you ask to push it.
